discovery_channels.evidence: The registry exposed installable, non-deprecated JavaScript utility packages and provided dated publication, license, repository, and usage signals.

discovery_channels.channel: GitHub language, size, public-status, and update search
discovery_channels.evidence: A constrained source search deliberately sampled small public JavaScript repositories and surfaced current alternatives such as pretty-bytes and p-map rather than using popularity as an admission rule.
Reviewing the maintainer's small single-purpose JavaScript libraries supplied slash and corroborated escape-string-regexp as real package source rather than tutorial code.
